notes: Which agent may call which tool. The owner picks the agent when approving a client on the consent page; the grant is bound to that agent. approval_required lists tools that need the owner's approval on every call for that agent (tools marked requiresApproval in code always do). An admin override in KV (PUT /admin/api/policy) takes precedence until it is deleted.

duet.description: Claude Duet, through a claude.ai custom connector

animamesh.description: AnimaMesh: repo counts only, nothing Duet can call

inspector.description: Manual testing with MCP Inspector or a scripted client
